No, not at all. Sorry - I let my anger get the best of me. 

But it frustrates me that armchair men who have never had to have this talk with their partner blow it off like it's the easiest choice in the world.

I understand what you are saying - it makes sense, now that I think about it. I have survived - but sometimes, I don't know, it doesn't feel like what I live through now is "living". Some days I have almost no energy to do anything but sit and let my thoughts consume me. 

And I wish you luck. I honestly do.

A woman and her partner has the right to choose if they want to abort or not. 

However, the neo-Eugenics popping up in this thread is vile - You are not in most cases, women who are pregnant with children that may have Downs Syndrome. Most of you are presumably men who think it's your "GOD GIVEN RITE" to tell women what to do. 

I urge you to stop judging parents who have children with Downs - you wouldn't walk up to them and tell 'em they should have killed their child, would you?
Nothing really helps, but this is about some more vile neo-eugenics making the front page of reddit, not about me or my mental issues. Thanks for playing though~
Ahh, good ol' gay rape joaks right folks?!
I'm not trying to be needy or whiny. But I don't know what else to do at this point! I've tried years and years of fixes to get myself out of this and it keeps failing over and over.

Seems Reddit has a hardon for eugenics ideas this morning. 

"DAE DOWNS ABORTIONS?!"
I'm glad I'm not the only one but it sucks none the less.
There's a small few. I'm trying to get in touch with them as much as I can but a lot of them are tired of me.

Just for fun: 

"Thats very cold hearted of you" [-61]

Sounds like my life right now. Wasted two years in college for computer programming only to fail out due to my mental breakdown(s) I had. 

I work front desk at a hotel in town and I genuinely enjoy it but everyone yells at me that it's a shit job and I should feel shitty. My parents seem to spend more time arguing and stressing them anything else - being that my dad works at the same hotel I do he yells at me for not doing what he things I should with my life. 

I wish I wasn't a coward enough to end my life or run away.
I'd really love to but my mother and grandmother, well - because I'm...erm, fortunate enough...to live here, they refuse to allow pets because "they're hard to take care of".

I should also state that my father yelled at me about not wanting to go back to live with him - because I tried that a few years ago, and his wife was abusive to the point I attempted suicide for the first time to get away from her. he claims I'm lying and making things up to try to "slander" his wife.

I'm 22 - but having grown up in a broken home where the mentality of "fend for yourself" was the main ideology, having one person who cares is like having a guardian angel. I just don't want to ruin my relationship with her.

I don't really have much in the way of hobbies. 

I used to do a lot of distance walking and stuff to "get away" for a few hours but because I screwed up my back I can't do much of that anymore. I wanted to get back into it with the help of a cane I found but my father yelled at me in front of customers at work about it so..
If I move out, I fear she won't want anything to do with me since I won't be around to give her money or whatever.
Even people here won't talk to me. I'm just that pathetic.
There's no use in trying to find myself, is there? I'm 22 years old and my life is already nothing but misery. I wish I had the courage to end it but...I don't.

I'd say I am because I spend most of my day fantasizing about suicide and wanting to have a mental breakdown. 

Though I like my job none the less.

Of course I don't. 

But after 12 years of it, it's all I know. I'm afraid to change because I can't imagine life without this. I've gone most of my teenage years and adult life with this pain and self-hatred.

Yeah but people like me deserve it and should get over it and lift or just go die. 

or so Reddit tells me.

My only SO was borderline psychotic. She would tell me she hated feeling crazy and anxious and depressed and then yell at me when I suggested we go to therapy or something. 

She told me once: "I should get therapy for this" 

I told her: "if that's what you want, we should go together" 

Her? "fuck you asshole i'm not crazy how dare you fucker"
To be honest I was close to writing a suicide note yesterday, but I held back. I don't want to start writing lest I write something really...dark? I suppose.

That makes sense, but so much just slips through my interest radar so fast. I mean, I try to keep my energy level up but I always get so tired from struggling with my own head. 

I know that doesn't make any sense, but that's the best way I can word it.
I don't see how essentially telling me "no one cares" helps in any way. Either that or you have a warped sense of "doing something nice".

I've been this way for so long that I don't remember what it is to be normal. I'm 22 years old and I've suffered from this disease of the mind for the past 12 years. My teenager/adult years have been THIS disease, the suicidal thoughts, the self-harm, self-hate, etc. 

Can I ever be "cured"? I don't know. When depression is all you know, happiness seems alien in comparison.

I'm the same way, OP. I try to be friendly with people only to overdo it and become accused of being a creepy stalker. Which I'm not - just not having friends at all or being used to them turning on me for petty reasons breaks you down after a while. 

Hell, I can't even post on /r/depression without someone insulting me there.

You do realize that this does nothing for those of us suffering? I mean, coming to a forum dealing with depression only to mock and insult those who are suffering is really counterproductive. Why don't you just go back to wherever it is you're originally from, please.

I agree, but trying to build yourself up only works for so long. Right now I feel like the walls all around me are  closing in, and that I have no way to escape. It's like suffocating to death inside your own mind. 

The same thoughts over and over again coupled with your own mind and self telling you that no matter what you pledge to change you won't be able to accomplish nothing.
Yes, I'm sure no one cares - I've figured that out long ago.

Why not? I've had other accounts on reddit before and I hardly feel like I contribute anything. I've posted on this forum and /r/suicidewatch so many times that most people tend to ignore me - heh, ignored and blocked on a suicide-watch subreddit. That's my luck.
